Welcome, Brothers

Tacoma Alumni Chapter of Sigma Chi

Established on April 6, 1911, the Tacoma Alumni Chapter provides opportunities to our alumni brothers living in, working in or visiting the South Puget Sound to remain involved with and honor their lifelong commitment to the Fraternity after graduation.

Join the Chapter → Upcoming Events
Est. April 6, 1911 · South Puget Sound
A Lifelong Commitment

More than a chapter, a family

The site is also a place for partners, Sweethearts, Little Sisters, children and the rest of the extended family of Brothers to remain connected.

Our alumni chapter and its members also provide support to our undergraduate brothers, especially those of Delta Phi Chapter at University of Puget Sound, the nearest undergraduate chapter.

All brothers are welcome

Membership in Tacoma Alumni Chapter is open to all brothers regardless of their undergraduate chapter affiliation.

Become a member →

Engage with Us

Stay part of the brotherhood

There are many ways for alumni brothers to remain engaged with the Fraternity, our Alumni Chapter and the local undergraduate chapter, Delta Phi at University of Puget Sound.

Donate

Alumni donations to the Sigma Chi Foundation support the Fraternity's leadership initiatives and educational scholarship needs of its members.

Give to the Foundation →

Mentor

Alumni mentors provide meaningful direction and guidance to undergraduate brothers and can get them on a path to success after graduation.

Volunteer

Alumni volunteers work directly with our brothers and leaders and serve as liaisons between the chapter and various community interests.

Facilitate

Alumni facilitate many of the Fraternity's leadership development programs and provide wisdom and guidance to our undergraduate brothers.

Contact us to learn more about how you can engage in these various opportunities.

Contact Leadership →

Membership

Join the Tacoma Alumni Chapter

Membership is open to all brothers regardless of their undergraduate chapter affiliation.

Eligibility

Who can join

All alumni brothers in good standing with the General Fraternity are welcome to join our alumni chapter and become full members by paying dues.

To apply for membership please contact us and provide your name, the chapter and date of your initiation and the year and institution you graduated from.

All undergraduate brothers in good standing are welcome to engage with our chapter and attend our events.

Membership application

Dues
$35 / year

Our alumni chapter is entirely self-funded. We rely entirely on the generosity of our brothers who support us. Dues can be paid online via PayPal or Venmo.

PayPal

Scan or Click to pay with PayPal.

Venmo

Scan or Click to pay with Venmo.

Mail a check

Or you may mail a check to:

Tacoma Sigma Chi Alumni Chapter
2114 N Frace St
Tacoma, WA  98406-2218

If you would prefer to pay your dues by cash please contact us.
